units.source_text: 那种气味近似熟透了的杏子。

en.t: That smell was something like fully ripened apricots.

units.source_text: 他行走在火灾后的废墟上，隐约嗅到这样的气味，

en.t: As he walked through the ruins left by the fire, he faintly caught that smell,

units.source_text: 于是想着：暑天里的腐尸，气味竟然也不算很难闻。

en.t: and thought: even a corpse rotting in summer does not smell all that terrible after all.

units.source_text: 但是当他站在尸骸遍地的池畔时，才知道“鼻子发酸”这句话十分准确。

en.t: But when he stood beside the pond where corpses lay everywhere, he realized how exact the phrase "making the nose sting" really was.

units.source_text: 一个十二三岁的小孩的尸体让他尤其心动。

en.t: The body of a child of twelve or thirteen moved him especially.

units.source_text: 他望着那具尸体，觉得有些羡慕。

en.t: Looking at that body, he felt a little envious.

units.source_text: 他想起“上帝所宠爱的人都活不长”这句话。

en.t: He remembered the saying, "Those loved by God do not live long."

units.source_text: 他的姐姐和异母兄弟的家都被大火烧毁了。

en.t: The homes of his elder sister and his half brother had both been destroyed by the great fire.

units.source_text: 而且他的姐夫因为犯了伪证罪，被判缓期服刑……

en.t: Moreover, because his brother-in-law had committed perjury, he had been given a suspended sentence...
